about_short_description.short_description: Munify provides stablecoin-powered cross-border payments and AI-driven workflow tools for financial services.

product.name: Cross-Border Payments
product.description: A platform for sending and receiving money internationally through fiat and stablecoin payment rails, with support for multiple currencies and local payout channels.

product.name: Multi-Currency Accounts
product.description: Accounts for holding, managing, and exchanging multiple currencies, with unique bank details for receiving deposits and payments. USD is available; EUR and GBP are listed as forthcoming.

product.name: Payouts
product.description: An API- and dashboard-based service for sending global payouts to bank accounts, digital wallets, and prepaid cards, with currency conversion and transaction monitoring.

product.name: USD Virtual Cards
product.description: Virtual payment cards funded in USD for online and in-store spending, with multi-currency payments, real-time transaction visibility, card controls, and spending limits.

product.name: Cards Issuance
product.description: Embedded card-issuing infrastructure that lets businesses create and manage virtual cards through APIs, dashboards, and a branded mobile experience.

product.name: Send Money
product.description: A transfer service for sending funds across borders in supported fiat currencies and digital assets, with transactions designed for delivery within seconds or minutes.
